text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired — gpu.alloc.failure on pool-west2a-gpu-p3. 37 alloc failures in last 2m, increasing error 5xx for inference routes. Auto-throttle kicked in.
PagerDuty: Page #PD-98321: severity: high. Acknowledge required. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98321
Ava (oncall): ACK — I'm on it. pinging SRE.
Ravi (sre): on my way, grabbing logs. which model is hitting it?
Ava (oncall): Looks like llama-7b-q4a and a few customer deployed variants. Errors in pod logs show repeated cuMemAlloc() failures and "CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED".
Mia (infra): seeing NVML OOM spikes on node gpu-w2a-07, kernel messages 'out of memory' and mmap failures. Pod list: inference-serve-7d8c, inference-serve-9j2k, batch-worker-3.
Ravi (sre): ok start with soft mitigation: 1) drain noisy node 2) scale up burst pool 3) route traffic to fallback model variant.
Ava (oncall): I'll drain node gpu-w2a-07. command:
```
kubectl drain gpu-w2a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
Ava (oncall): starting drain now.
deploy-bot: deployment/inference-serve scaled from 6 to 10 replicas (triggered by Ava).
Ravi (sre): I'm creating a temporary burst pool. Mia can you spin up dedicated-burst-1 (4x A100) in west2?
Mia (infra): provisioning burst pool now, ETA ~3m. spinning up nodes and attaching to k8s.
Ravi (sre): also toggling KV cache eviction threshold lower for affected model to reduce memory pressure. command:
```
redwoodctl config set inference.kvcache.eviction_threshold=0.6 --model llama-7b-q4a --env prod
```
Ava (oncall): drain completed, pods evicted. Some pods failed to restart due to image pull backoff (timing) — I'm re-creating failed ones.
ops-bot: node gpu-w2a-07 cordoned and drained by Ava. Evicted 3 pods.
Ravi (sre): after drain, observing alloc failures drop from 37->9 in last 1m. latency still elevated x2.
PagerDuty: Page acknowledged by Ava (oncall) at 3416000012. Escalation paused.
Ava (oncall): quick customer check — sending note to CS: "We are mitigating a GPU OOM spike affecting a subset of inference requests in west2. Some requests may see errors/latency. We're routing traffic to fallback instances."
Mia (infra): burst pool ready, joining cluster. kubectl label nodes dedicated-burst-1 role=burst
Ravi (sre): scaling deployment onto burst nodes:
```
kubectl patch deployment inference-serve -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"role":"burst"}}}}}'
```
Ravi (sre): routing rule updated to send 20% traffic to burst pool for affected model.
Ava (oncall): errors down to 1-2 per minute. latency back to ~1.2x baseline.
Ravi (sre): looking at kernel logs from gpu-w2a-07 — there are repeated mmap failures: "failed to allocate memory: out of GPU memory (cudaErrorMemoryAllocation)". Suspect fragmentation combined with large batch requests.
Mia (infra): adding kernel param change to reduce memory reclamation pressure on that host, but will schedule during low risk window. For now we rely on burst nodes and throttling.
Ava (oncall): handoff time in ~15m. If stable we can hand to next rotation.
Ravi (sre): adding followups: 1) investigate batch sizing heuristics, 2) add preemptive eviction when KV cache > 70%, 3) postmortem if reoccurs.
Ava (oncall): marking this thread as mitigated for now. I'll leave PagerDuty note and handoff to @ravi in 15.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-98321 status -> acknowledged -> resolved (pending manual close) once oncall confirms.
Ava (oncall): short runbook note for postmortem: affected pool: pool-west2a-gpu-p3; root symptoms: KV cache pressure + large concurrent batches -> CUDA alloc failures; mitigation: drain node, scale burst nodes, reduce eviction threshold, route traffic.
Ravi (sre): thanks team. I'll pick this up for postmortem and link metrics/dashboards.
Mia (infra): filing infra ticket to add fragmentation checks and kernel tuning playbook.
Ava (oncall): handing off — next oncall please monitor 20m and close PD if stable. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: handoff recorded. next-oncall: Ravi (sre).
Ava (oncall): closing thread in slack, will update PD and internal incident tracker.
